description: The latest archived transactions across the network, newest first, optionally narrowed to one type and/or one address. Use it for 'what is happening now'. For one address's complete history with paging use get_address.

address.description: only txs sent or received by this poa1... address

limit.description: maximum txs to return (1 to 200, default 20)

type.description: only this tx type, e.g. challenge, grade-sealed, attest-batch, join, transfer, swap-offer or swap-fill; the result's types lists every type seen

name: list_transactions
title: Recent transactions
